takeoff.note: Aircraft centre must be inside the short-edge takeoff area; capture a fresh session origin. Coordinates are in the surveyed venue frame, not LIO world.

vehicle.note: Envelope includes propellers and is measured relative to the FC centre; do not subtract a guessed radius.

tracking_policy: FC pose timestamp matched to previously sent position/velocity reference

post_takeoff_position_policy.abort_boundary: Configured outer venue including propeller-inclusive vehicle envelope

planning_wait_policy.action: Hold the leg start until a verified trajectory arrives or the operator stops

navigation_goal_policy.policy: SUPER accepted free-space goal inside vehicle-inclusive venue

search_policy.termination: Goal/horizon reached or finite admissible grid exhausted; operator can interrupt

rehearsal_viewer.arrow_direction: vehicle body +X in raw planner world; not velocity
